  • Method Details

    • depot

      public RoutingBuilder depot(String id, double lat, double lon)
      Registers a depot location that vehicles may depart from and return to.

      This method is accumulative: each call adds another depot, in declaration order. The first registered depot is the default for vehicles that do not specify one via VehicleConfig.startsAt(String) / VehicleConfig.endsAt(String). At least one depot is required.

      Throws:
      ModelException - if id is blank or a depot with this id was already registered

    • vehicle

      public RoutingBuilder vehicle(String id, Consumer<VehicleConfig> config)
      Adds a single vehicle configured by the lambda, which receives a fresh VehicleConfig.

    • vehicles

      public RoutingBuilder vehicles(int count, Consumer<VehicleConfig> config)
      Adds count identical vehicles configured by the same lambda. Generated ids are "vehicle-N" for the smallest N not already taken, so they never collide with ids declared via vehicle(String, Consumer).

    • stop

      public RoutingBuilder stop(String id, Consumer<StopConfig> config)
      Adds a stop (delivery/pickup node) configured by the lambda, which receives a fresh StopConfig.

    • pickupAndDelivery

      public RoutingBuilder pickupAndDelivery(String pickupStopId, String deliveryStopId)
      Requires pickupStopId to be visited before deliveryStopId by the same vehicle. The pickup stop's demand is the load carried between the two; the delivery stop's demand must be omitted or equal to it. When dropping is allowed, the two stops are dropped together and the penalty is paid per stop; if the two stops have different penalties, the larger one applies to both. Ids may be declared later; they are resolved when the problem is built.

    • pickupAndDeliveryPolicy

      public RoutingBuilder pickupAndDeliveryPolicy(PickupDeliveryPolicy policy)
      Ordering policy among pickup-and-delivery pairs on one vehicle; default PickupDeliveryPolicy.ANY.

    • distances

      public RoutingBuilder distances(DistanceSource source)
      Sets how inter-node distances are sourced; defaults to DistanceSource.haversine().

    • allowDroppingStops

      public RoutingBuilder allowDroppingStops(long penalty)
      Allows stops to be dropped from routes. The penalty is added to the objective for each unserved stop, so the solver only drops a stop when it is cheaper than serving it. 0 (the default) makes every stop mandatory unless it sets its own penalty, which takes precedence over this one.
      Throws:
      ModelException - if penalty is negative

    • goal

      public RoutingBuilder goal(RoutingGoal routingGoal)
      Sets the optimization goal; defaults to Goals.totalDistance().

    • travelSpeedKmh

      public RoutingBuilder travelSpeedKmh(double speedKmh)
      Average vehicle speed used to convert distances to travel times for time-window constraints. Default: 40 km/h. Typical values: urban 20–30, suburban 50, highway 90. Ignored when DistanceSource.fromMatrices(long[][], long[][]) supplies travel times.
